_note: PK inputs for the one-compartment oral model. Each value carries its source. 'derived' = computed by this project from sourced values, not read from a label.

V_L.source: XELJANZ US label 12.3 (volume of distribution after IV dose)

t_half_h.source: XELJANZ label: elimination half-life about 3 h

tmax_h.source: XELJANZ label Table 8: median Tmax 1.0 h (0.5-14.0)

reported_ss.source: XELJANZ label Table 8, 5 mg BID (population not RA-specific)

reported_ss_ra.source: XELJANZ label Table 9, RA 5 mg BID

CL_F_L_h.source: derived: dose / AUCinf, 15 mg single dose = 15000 ug / 0.265 ug.h/mL

t_half_h.source: RINVOQ label: terminal half-life 8-14 h (midpoint used)

tmax_h.source: RINVOQ label: median Tmax 2-4 h (midpoint used)

fu.source: protein binding 52% (DrugBank via findmeds.uk; secondary source, not the label)

reported_single_dose.source: RINVOQ label 12.3, 15 mg fasting healthy subjects
